verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's evidence documents only the server side: an official MCP server that external AI agents connect to in order to query Honeycomb data, plus agent skills for coding assistants. Nothing shows Honeycomb's own AI features (Query Assistant, Canvas) can consume tools from external MCP servers. An observability platform with built-in AI could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it.
